algorithm_contract.classifier: C-SVC trained per crossed outer donor/genomic split, cell state, and fixed project seed, using all permitted training blocks in that split, on training-fold ATAC peak versus matched nonpeak sequences
algorithm_contract.model_family_relationship: The fold/state/seed model artifacts are the same artifacts consumed by deltaSVM. Direct gkm-SVM scoring and deltaSVM are related readouts, not independent trained families.
algorithm_contract.training_window: Exactly 300 bp [summit-150, summit+150) around each outer-training peak summit

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No historical or bundled biological weight is admitted. Each project model is trained inside crossed donor/genomic folds and frozen as a gzip text model with its receipt, source/environment locks, and SHA-256.

input_contract.alphabet: Uppercase A/C/G/T only. Reject N, ambiguity codes, lowercase, empty records, mixed lengths, and records longer than 2047 bp before native parsing.
input_contract.canonical_reference: GRCh38.p14 with project checksum, coordinate, and REF-allele validation
input_contract.snp_window: Exactly 300 bp [variant_pos0-150, variant_pos0+150), with the validated allele at zero-based index 150
input_contract.strand: Do not pass -R; reverse complements are one feature. Require raw-score reverse-complement equivalence within a prespecified numeric tolerance.
input_contract.boundary_policy: Reject incomplete or unresolved windows; never pad or accept the upstream first-2047-base truncation behavior.

negative_sampling_contract.matching: Within the same permitted chromosome/block, sample one nonpeak 300-bp window per positive without replacement, matching exact length, GC fraction within 0.02, mappability within 0.05 with minimum 0.80, outer-training log1p-ATAC decile, TSS-distance bin, and repeat fraction within 0.05.
negative_sampling_contract.no_match_policy: Record and drop the unmatched positive; matching tolerances cannot be relaxed after any outcome is observed.
negative_sampling_contract.ordering: Deterministic nearest-distance match and salted row-ID tie break under the fixed project seed; exact and reverse-complement duplicate sequences stay grouped.
negative_sampling_contract.peak_construction: Peaks, summits, accessibility, and the matching pool are derived only from outer-training donor-by-cell-state ATAC.

output_and_task_contract.native_output: Raw LIBSVM decision value from gkmpredict for one 300-bp sequence; positive values favor the locally trained ATAC-peak class.
output_and_task_contract.positive_delta_interpretation: The ALT sequence is predicted to look more like the local cell-state accessibility-positive class than REF.
output_and_task_contract.task_role: mandatory secondary sequence/accessibility baseline; optional component of a separately frozen link-plus-direction composite
output_and_task_contract.deltaSVM_distinction: This full-window decision-value difference is not labeled deltaSVM. deltaSVM separately sums proxy 11-mer weights over only variant-overlapping k-mers and uses native REF-minus-ALT orientation.

runtime_contract.build: Pinned Makefile with campaign-frozen CXX, -Wall -Wconversion -O3 -fPIC, and -lm -lpthread -lz
runtime_contract.internal_cross_validation: disabled; -x and -r are not passed. Project seed governs matching and deterministic record order.

require_before_native_load: A/C/G/T support-vector sequences of exactly 300 bp
safe_loading_contract.silent_truncation_guard: The native FASTA reader can warn and silently retain the first 2047 bases. The project adapter must reject before execution.
safe_loading_contract.untrusted_native_parser_warning: Only prevalidated project-generated text models may reach the C/zlib parser.

source_evidence: The exact LS-GKM commit, GPL-3.0 license, parameter defaults, model serializer/loader, FASTA truncation behavior, threading modes, and Makefile were inspected on 2026-08-22. No source was compiled, no weights or data were downloaded, and no model was run.

terms_audit.derivative_weight_redistribution: No upstream model is admitted. Release of project-trained models remains conditional on source-data rights and institutional review; distributed source modifications retain GPL obligations.
